- If implementation requires a new effect, memo, callback hook or subscription, list the reason and ask for the owner's OK before adding it. The frame-loop/ref route is the default.

## How to check it

1. Load a deterministic QA save with Rong, Zhen and Maid He present; inspect each on their scheduled visit or in the QA fixture.
2. Speak to each and offer a present. Read distinct voices and contextual reply choices.
3. Change bond/rank through QA fixtures. Check address, warmth and etiquette without changing gift effects.
4. Walk toward a group. Read at most two short barks; open dialogue/menu and check they disappear.
5. See a taste hint, open Brush Notes and confirm it is suspected and attributed. Re-approach; it should not duplicate.
6. Save after a committed response and reload. Confirm the line is unchanged. Repeat with an older save.
7. Check a narrow phone viewport, reduced motion and software rendering; names, barks and accessible subtitles remain usable.

## Done when

- `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass.
- You loaded the game and looked at the change.
- The ten-person coverage and content-budget receipt are included in the PR; the other 38 resolve safely.
- No getResponse path remains, and cosmetic dialogue/barks leave gameplay RNG untouched.
- Code review done with GPT-6.1 Sol via T3 delegate_task (owner's rule).

title: S2b: Real presents, courtier tastes, the satchel and the steward
body:
> Part of #2 · Slice S2b · Size XL · Depends on: #3, #4, #5, #6

## What changes for the player

- Carry named tea, silk, books, adornments and other presents in a satchel.
- Learn each courtier's tastes through reactions. Brush Notes retain the evidence and its source.
- Choose a written reply before presenting. A warm or cool response changes this watch's mood.
- Buy presents from a steward near each accessible compound's south gate. Sell unwanted items for their full worth.
- Pledged allies send named presents worth the same as their former silver income. Tribute accepts taels or several items together.
- See etiquette, known verdicts and named witnesses before committing. Scholar's View stays on until the learner balance gate passes.

## Why

- Current presents are four message tones evaluated asynchronously; the machine enters `gift_processing` (`src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:293`, `src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:799`).
- Preview computes only direct effects while political witnesses are handled separately (`src/lib/courtStrategy.ts:12`, `src/lib/courtIntrigue.ts:7`). One transaction must own the whole receipt.
- Courtier actors own reward flags and mirror the court graph through serials (`src/state-machines/character-machine.ts:40`, `src/state-machines/character-machine.ts:44`). Replacing gifts must preserve that protocol.
- The simulator chooses from exact previews and displayed personality (`scripts/simulate-campaign.ts:90`, `scripts/simulate-campaign.ts:96`). Its current strategic policy cannot validate learning through reactions.

## Scope

1. **Freeze the comparison before deleting anything.** Record the current three-career, four-policy baseline with `SIM_REPORT_PATH=/tmp/sim-S2b-before.json node --import tsx scripts/simulate-campaign.ts 100 1 60`. Use the same seeds and horizon for every comparison. #3 supplies the approved learner target and #4 supplies the minimal `CourtView` and scene.
   - Measure the one-present-per-courtier-per-watch cap alone against the old rules before adding tastes, mood or stock scarcity. A simulation-only variant is sufficient; keep one production path.
   - Require #5 to resolve untimed 2D before merging: remove it, or deliver equivalent steward access and explicit watch limits. Do not leave retained 2D players with an exhausted starter satchel.
2. **Author the catalogue and tastes.** Add about 36 records with stable `id`, `name`, `emblem`, `category`, `grade: 1|2|3|4`, `tags`, `blurb` and procedural `prop` key. Worth is 1/5/10/20 taels by grade; recipient etiquette uses office tier (`src/lib/courtHierarchy.ts:3`).
   - Include jasmine sprig g1, jasmine pearls g2, Dragon Well g3, aged Pu'er g4; handkerchief g2, Suzhou silk g3, kesi g4; Xuan paper g2, inkstone g3; silver hairpin g2, kingfisher hairpin g3, phoenix buyao g4; sandalwood g1, ginseng g3, agarwood g4; Book of Songs g2, Sunzi g3; thumb ring g3, jade bi g4; cakes g1, lychees g3; reform pamphlet g2, border-army report g3; cricket cage g1, snuff bottle g2, go set g4. Fill the remaining records with the same grade and tag rules.
   - Office defaults cover all 48 names: maids practical/sweet, scholars books/ink, generals martial, consorts adornment/silk, Dowager devotion. Author an explicit category allowlist for every other office; a broad shared tag must not make every item Pleasing.
   - Author one fixed love and one fixed loathe for Consorts Hua, Zhen, Rong, Yue and Concubines Mei, Lin, Xia, Yun, An, Qiao. These are the ten; rotating maids, including Maid He, use office defaults until #16.
   - Rong loves the g3 kingfisher hairpin and loathes g3 Lingnan lychees. Every signature item meets its recipient's tier. Cakes below Rong's tier teach etiquette only. A later Dowager loathe must be g4.
   - Budget this slice's content explicitly: 36 names/blurbs, ten love/loathe pairs with reaction and discovery lines, office defaults, contextual written replies, steward purchase/sale lines. #8 owns the full voice packs.
3. **Replace scoring with one pure transaction.** `giftOptions(scene)` uses the same resolver as `resolveGift(scene, request)`. Return an allowed flag/reason, complete effects, deciding rule, receipt and discovery facts. UI knowledge filters what is displayed; it never changes resolution.
   - Share hidden-trait thresholds through `stanceFit`: ambitious match at ambition >= .6 and loyalty <= .5; ambitious Affront at loyalty >= .5 OR ambition <= .5; loyal match at loyalty >= .7, loyal mismatch at ambition >= .7 and loyalty <= .5; fear fit at fear >= .5.
   - Resolve in this order: martial/ambitious/seditious affront to a courtier failing the ambitious fit under the loyal test; under-tier etiquette; authored loathe; signature love; political fit; office category fit; Proper. Tradition/tea mismatch is Unwelcome. Fear fit and office fit are at most Pleasing before mood.
   - Verdicts map to existing outcome keys and support values (`src/lib/campaignBalance.ts:28`): Treasured/match +20/+18, Pleasing/cautious +14/+12, Proper/neutral +10/+9 for prince-or-scholar/concubine; Unwelcome/dismissive -6; Affront/suspicious -12 and recipient suspicion +.3.
   - Warm lifts and Cool lowers one step through Unwelcome, Proper, Pleasing, Treasured. Cap at Treasured and floor at Unwelcome; Affront remains fixed. Record the base deciding rule separately from mood. Reveal a signature taste only when its rule was evaluated.
   - Scale positive intent by `(1 + .5 * (playerInfluence - npcInfluence)) * (enemy ? .10 : 1)`. Round once, halves away from zero; preserve legacy fractional support and report actual credited support. Negative intent retains full hate even at support zero; pledged/same-formal-faction immunity and pledge at 100 remain.
   - Preserve backing/pledge standing awards, recovery renewals and +.004 diplomacy influence for the first actually positive present per recipient per season. A rounded-zero gift grants none of these benefits.
   - Carry recipient trait changes explicitly: ambitious-fit ambition +.05 with positive scaling; fear-fit fear +.1; Affront suspicion +.3 and fearOfPlayer +.15. Clamp once and keep actor suspicion and personality suspicion synchronized (`src/lib/checkMessage.ts:18`, `src/lib/checkMessage.ts:23`). Delete player personality tone gains.
   - Witness risk follows the martial/ambitious tag that earns the ambitious fit, including Sunzi and the thumb ring, even when another rule also affects the verdict. For a Rebel recipient, Imperial/Loyalist unpledged witnesses gain +.10, multiplied by 1.5 when hostile. Tradition gives -.05 relief; intimate presents and proposals retain concubine witness risk +.1 per unpledged witness.
   - Intimate items add directed affection +15 only for an eligible pair. Keep consent, acceptance thresholds, refusal, breakup and jealousy rules. A present may affect politics and affection; it cannot create a lover implicitly.
   - Move the old >.6 influence remark lock and >.8 ambitious-item lock into transaction availability (`src/lib/influenceGating.ts:34`, `src/lib/influenceGating.ts:43`). Block martial/ambitious/seditious items above .8 until an explicit later decision changes this rule.
4. **Talk, memory and knowledge.** Written replies carry internal stance ids and contextual text; never show a fixed loyal/ambitious/neutral picker.
   - Talk is accepted once per courtier per watch. A match yields Warm and +2 support once per courtier per season, capped at backer threshold minus 1; if already above that cap, grant zero without lowering support. A mismatch yields Cool and zero support; neutral yields no mood change. Mood expires at the next watch.
   - Talk gives no reputation or personality gains. Accepted presents alone nudge perceived loyalty (+.02 for tradition/loyal fit) or threat (+.05 for ambitious fit), once with the transaction; clamp to [0,1]. Pardon keeps perceivedLoyalty > .8.
   - Brush Notes store observed or suspected facts with source kind, season, watch and source text. Facts from etiquette failures cannot claim a love/loathe. Preserve fixed authored tastes across runs; knowledge in this slice is saved campaign data. Cross-run knowledge sharing belongs to #16.
5. **Steward, inventory and tribute.** Give each new/migrated career exactly three starter items from a fixed table, with no RNG draw. Use a compact strip; 24 distinct ids and stacks of nine are validation bounds rather than a visible slot-management task.
   - Six stock entries per season, with at least one item of each currently reachable court tier. All compound stalls share that season's stock. Purchases debit taels and stock atomically; sales return full catalogue worth. Reject full satchels before charging.
   - Pledged allies choose an office-liked item of exact old worth 1/5/10 (`src/lib/campaignBalance.ts:42`). Retain `courtGiftSeasons`, immediate pledge payment and settlement after casualties (`src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:1179`). No deceased ally pays. If an item cannot fit, credit its full worth in taels; never silently discard income.
   - Add an immutable uint32 `campaignSeed`; stock uses `campaignStream(campaignSeed, season, 'stock')`. New games seed once and use that seed to initialize gameplay RNG. Restock never reads or advances the live `rngState`.
   - Support tribute worth 10/20/40 now (`src/lib/campaignBalance.ts:19`): taels, a selected multi-item bundle, or a bundle topped up with taels. Validate counts, consume atomically and return excess worth as taels. Two g4 items cover 40.
   - Pardon applies only when the combined available taels and satchel worth cannot cover tribute. A player holding payable items cannot claim poverty (`src/lib/playerVector.ts:46`). Extend the existing tribute UI; #13 owns its cinematic replacement. Present tribute is primary; refusal needs confirmation and is never the default Enter target.
6. **Route acts once and project results.** Add discriminated `SOCIAL_ACT` payloads for talk/present/remark/propose/end and `WORLD_ACT` for buy/sell. Include request id, campaign session, season/watch and frozen scene evidence; present requires item id, Talk requires reply id.
   - `applySocialAct(campaign, act) -> {campaign, actorEvents, notices, receipt}` folds graph commands and updates inventory, knowledge, mood and the shared request ledger. The machine only adapts actor snapshots, assigns the result and sends returned actor events. No actor calls, clocks, storage or timers inside rules.
   - Validate career access, presence, living actor identity, current season/watch, quantity and duplicates at commit. Reject stale scenes before any mutation. New request ids cannot bypass a presented-this-watch entry; old ids cannot replay after reload or restart.
   - Freeze named witnesses and their relevant attributes when the scene opens; carry that evidence through preview and commit. #11 later changes how the list is sampled. Reopening a scene must build fresh options. If relevant campaign facts change, reject and refresh rather than silently alter the shown result.
   - Introduce parent-originated `APPLY_SOCIAL_RESULT {session, requestId, serial, relation, traits, suspicion, response, newlyPledged}`. At a settled actor, parent allocates serial = committed serial + 1 and advances `graphAppliedCommands`; child accepts only that next serial/current session, then sets both command and projection serials to it. Reject duplicate/stale delivery. Preserve the existing child-initiated protocol; refuse parent acts while a child command is outstanding.
   - Apply relation, traits, suspicion, faction-follow and lastResponse together. Actor always-transitions remain the sole source of backing/pledge standing awards and report checks; emit the existing allegiance notification once for a new pledge. Keep the activating serial-equality guard working (`src/state-machines/character-machine.ts:94`). Save only after all projections and award/report messages settle.
   - Remark replaces both parent and child `SPIT_IN_FACE`: support -20, hate 100 unless immune, target suspicion +.5 at pre-act support zero or +.3 otherwise, same-recipient-faction fallout +.1. Resolve from supplied court facts synchronously. Use a two-step confirmation; it is never the default focus or Enter target.
   - Emit result notices through #6's existing API. Do not redesign notice storage, acknowledgment, alerts or Chronicle here. Defer gather/listen/favour/rumour verbs to #11/#12.
7. **Wire the visible slice.** Add `SatchelStrip` to #4's non-modal scene and Brush Notes to its dossier. Slots show Emblem, grade knots, known verdict or '?', etiquette seal and watch-limit reason; prices appear at the steward.
   - Provide labelled keyboard/touch controls and a Back action. Display named witnesses on focus. Use non-WASD shortcuts; Esc leaves satchel first, then scene, then opens the menu.
   - Build a lacquer steward stall outside the persistent 48-courtier roster, reachable near every accessible south gate. Each gift category gets an Emblem and a low-poly procedural prop using the existing present animation; #17 is optional.
   - Use theme tokens, display/body fonts, minimum 13px body text, one primary action, PopNumber and existing cues. Put new HUD styles in `src/ui/theme/hud.css`; delete replaced legacy styles. Update AGENTS.md's HUD/style exception and the gift-transaction roadmap entry. No emoji or generic box panels.
8. **Rewrite the simulator and gate the final economy.** Replace imports of deleted messages/previews and send the production item/act/payment interfaces. Inject campaign seeds; remove the global `Math.random` seed override (`scripts/simulate-campaign.ts:29`).
   - The new `omniscient` item policy is the comparison point for the old strategic baseline. Retain casual/focused/bad behaviour and add `learner` and `explorer`. Give every policy the real watch caps, stock, prices, ally liquidity, Talk and item tribute rules.
   - Learner sees only office tags, grade/etiquette, tried verdicts, Brush Notes and named witnesses. It cannot read hidden traits, exact effects or unknown tastes, even while Scholar's View remains on for rollout.
   - Report every policy/career's promotion rate, median first/top promotion, wins, deaths/reports and unresolved runs. Preserve null medians for no promotions. Omniscient first promotion stays within +/-1 season and wins within 10 percentage points of the measured baseline.
   - Use #3's owner-approved learner band; if absent, obtain it before hiding numbers or declaring done. Proposed band: first promotion within +3 seasons of omniscient and win rate >=40% in each career. Record all policy deltas; do not gate only the omniscient bot.
   - Keep career targets, influence targets and deadlines fixed. Tune stock availability, authored tag distribution and Talk only within the stated rules. Attach the cap-only and full-economy reports to the PR; re-run the item-tribute gate when #13 changes its flow.

## Delete in the same PR

- `evaluateGift`, `PendingGift`, `gift_processing`, evaluate/apply/settle/finalize handling, refund branches, `GIFT_APPLIED`, `FINALIZE_GIFT`, `APPLY_EVALUATED_GIFT` and gift-only actor acknowledgments.
- `GIVE_GIFT_WITH_MESSAGE`, all of `ROMANCE_ACTION` (gift/propose/end), both `SPIT_IN_FACE` events and their delayed fallout. Remove `giveRomanticGift`; intimate items use the graph's affection command. Preserve proposal, breakup, eligibility and jealousy rules.
- `giftMessages.ts`, the `checkMessage.ts` wrapper, `previewMessage`, `influenceGating.ts`, playerVector tone deltas and #4's `courtesyPresents` bridge. Move necessary rounding, sanitization, availability and pardon behaviour behind the new interfaces; remove unused exports/imports.
- Old gift/romance request ledgers and session fields after migration into the shared act protocol. Remove obsolete pending UI checks. Delete any surviving `RomanceActions` UI once its replacements are wired.
- Notice deletion/migration remains #6's responsibility. Adapt its gift payloads here; preserve its acknowledgment/read-state behaviour.

## New or changed modules

| Module | Interface and hidden behaviour |
|---|---|
| `src/data/court/{giftCatalogue,courtierTastes}.ts` | Stable item ids, grade worth, office defaults and fixed signatures; one source of content truth. |
| `src/lib/stanceFit.ts` | `stanceFit(stance, personality)`; shared trait boundaries and outcome keys. |
| `src/lib/giftTransaction.ts` | `giftOptions(scene)`, `resolveGift(scene, request)`; scoring, mood, etiquette, full effects and one receipt. |
| `src/lib/courtTalk.ts` | `talkOptions(scene)`, `resolveTalk(scene, request)`; contextual replies, mood and capped seasonal support. |
| `src/lib/satchel.ts` | `grant/take/has/canAfford/payTribute`; validated quantities, overflow rejection and combined payment. |
| `src/lib/brushNotes.ts` | `recordFacts/knownVerdict/notesFor`; evidence, suspected/observed status and bounded knowledge. |
| `src/lib/palaceSupply.ts` | `restock/buy/sell/allyPresent`; shared stock, exact-worth income, atomic inventory/purse changes. |
| `src/lib/campaignRandom.ts` | `campaignStream(seed, season, purpose)`; independent deterministic derived streams. |
| `src/lib/applySocialAct.ts` | `applySocialAct(campaign, act)`; deduplication, graph folding, typed actor results and notice intents. |
| `src/state-machines/{game-machine,character-machine}.ts` | Thin act routing and explicit serial-safe projection; actors retain awards/reports. |
| `src/persistence/campaignSave.ts`, `src/hud/SatchelStrip.tsx`, scene/dossier/steward adapters | v8 boundary validation and rendering from `CourtView`; no raw actor reads added to UI. |

## Tests

Interface tests only: call pure modules, drive `createActor`, render components or exercise the browser. No new source/CSS regex tests.

- Add catalogue/taste coverage for all 48 office defaults and the named ten signatures; ids, legal props, nonblank blurbs, usable signature grades and deterministic starter kits.
- Table-test stance boundaries and every verdict, mood step, authored discovery precedence, scaling/rounding, support caps, hate immunity, pledge, renewal and rounded-zero outcomes. Assert complete preview effects equal the accepted receipt, including witnesses and affection.
- Test frozen witnesses while NPCs move; Sunzi/thumb-ring Rebel exposure; tradition relief; intimate eligibility/risk; stale scene rejection, duplicate requests, watch rollover, Talk cap and no Talk reputation farming.
- Test stock determinism without gameplay RNG consumption, atomic buy/sell, overflow income fallback, casualties before ally payment, one seasonal payout, combined 40-worth tribute and payable-item pardon rejection.
- Test parent social projection followed by child commands and activation, reordered/duplicate results, award/report delivery once, terminal report handling, save/reload/restart and settled serial equality.
- Render satchel/dossier/steward fixtures with unknown/known verdicts, watch-lock reasons, names, prices, evidence, confirmation controls and accessible keyboard/touch labels. Verify reduced-motion reactions and scene focus return in the browser.

Every affected current suite gets the following replacement or port; retain unrelated assertions:

| Existing file under `tests/` | Replacement through a public interface |
|---|---|
| `giftTransactions.test.ts` | `giftTransaction` tables, synchronous machine commits and SatchelStrip rendering; delete async phase/refund and ActionButtons markup tests. |
| `messageScoring.test.ts` | `stanceFit`/`giftTransaction` boundaries, scaling and rounding; delete legacy message tests. |
| `courtStrategy.test.ts` | Replace preview/gating cases with transaction options; retain career, reward and rank-label cases. |
| `gameMachine.test.ts` | SOCIAL_ACT present/remark, complete witness receipts and once-only recovery; taels/item tribute. |
| `courtGraph.test.ts` | Parent social results plus child-command projections; remove direct child gift/spit sends. |
| `hateRules.test.ts` | Transaction loathe/Affront/remark cases at zero support and with immunity; retain rivalry cases. |
| `campaignSave.test.ts` | v7-to-v8 goldens, acts/payments, replay and malformed-v8 rejection; replace pending-gift/evaluator tests with unsettled-projection checkpoint tests. |
| `romanceLifecycle.test.ts` | Intimate inventory presents, SOCIAL_ACT propose/end, consent, jealousy and reports; remove claims that an intimate present leaves politics unchanged. |
| `courtRomance.test.ts` | Replace `giveRomanticGift` cases with affection-command/intimate-transaction cases; preserve NPC consent and jealousy coverage. |

title: S2a: Notices replace browser alerts and gameplay console logs
body:
> Part of #2 · Slice S2a · Size M · Depends on: #3

## What changes for the player

- Faction invitations, faction membership, collateral suspicion and imperial pardons appear as short palace notices.
- Notices leave movement and the season clock running. They never open a browser popup or steal focus.
- Notifications opens a scroll with recent notices, newest first, and an unread count.
- Pledged-ally gift receipts join the same history. Reading a receipt keeps the credited gifts in the purse.
- Notice history and read state survive saving and reloading.

## Why

- Five browser alerts interrupt play: `src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:666`, `:735`, `:873`, `:1054`, `:1071`.
- Gift collateral feedback only reaches the console at `src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:545`.
- Insult fallout waits 100 ms and retains captured campaign state: `src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:837` and `:879`.
- The current history covers gifts alone (`src/components/CourtNotifications.tsx:3`). Roadmap item 3 calls for notices in context (`docs/architecture/README.md:62`).

## Scope

1. Add the pure notices module and its interface tests.
   - `NoticeState = { entries: Notice[], nextSeq: number }`; retain the latest 60 entries in chronological order.
   - `pushNotice(state, { season, kind, severity, message, ...details }) -> NoticeState` creates an unread entry with id `${season}:${seq}`.
   - `ackNotices(state, ids) -> NoticeState` marks only those entries read. It retains history and the sequence counter.
   - Each entry stores its sequence and season. Use typed variants for gift, faction, court and imperial notices; severity is information or danger.
   - Gift details retain courtier name and amount 1, 5 or 10. They describe the existing currency payout in this slice.
   - Allocate a monotonically increasing sequence across seasons. Trimming or reading never reuses an id.
   - Accept season and details from the caller. Read no actors, browser globals, clock or RNG.
   - Existing transaction and income ledgers remain the authority for exactly-once outcomes; the bounded history cannot replace them.

2. Route committed machine outcomes through `pushNotice`; add root event `ACK_NOTICES { ids: string[] }`.
   - Faction invitation: replace the alert at `src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:666` with one invitation notice.
   - Handle newly inserted offers in the direct recomputations at `src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:564` and `:1178` too. Compare old/new offers; repeated checks produce no duplicate invitation.
   - Joining: replace `src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:735` with one summary naming the affected courtiers. Fold the gameplay meaning of logs at `:690`, `:695`, `:699`, `:710` and `:714` into that summary.
   - Gift collateral: persist the existing generated message at `src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:540` instead of logging it at `:545`.
   - Pardons: both `GIVE_EMPEROR_GIFT` and `REFUSE` bypass branches emit the existing pardon message (`src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:1054`, `:1071`). Keep their guards, charges and transitions intact.
   - Seasonal offer checks (`src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:1000`) produce notices only for new invitations. Delete progress/count/skip diagnostics.
   - Audience completion: remove payload/outcome dumps from guards at `src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:1300` and `:1348`. Emit one imperial notice in the committed outcome action; cover victory, execution and demotion through invoked completion and `EMPEROR_AUDIENCE_COMPLETE`. Use the existing message with a readable fallback for empty output.
   - Remove every direct `console.log` in this machine. Diagnostics become no player text; gameplay outcomes become the summaries above. Guards remain pure.
   - Initialize/reset notice state everywhere a campaign is initialized or restarted. Reformat the touched long functions.

3. Remove the delayed insult callback while preserving the existing actor protocol.
   - Calculate the same-faction collateral recipient list synchronously when the valid `SPIT_IN_FACE` action is accepted. The helper depends on faction membership (`src/lib/crossCharacterEffects.ts:87`, `:111`), which the target's insult projection does not change.
   - Keep the target event and its serial/projection flow (`src/state-machines/character-machine.ts:36`, `:70`). Enqueue the collateral suspicion events and one notice in the same machine turn.
   - Preserve support, hate, pledge immunity, target suspicion and same-faction suspicion amounts. Preserve current recipient selection; spatial witness changes belong to #11.
   - Reject unknown, absent or protected targets without a notice or collateral change. No timer, detached callback or post-stop mutation remains.
   - Keep `SPIT_IN_FACE` and its character event until #7 replaces the action.

4. Replace the gift-only history and both gift-notification writers.
   - Immediate income at `src/state-machines/game-machine.ts:591` and settled income at `:1182` append a gift notice in the same assignment as the payout.
   - Preserve `courtGiftSeasons`, settlement order, casualty exclusion and existing 1/5/10 payouts.
   - Replace the header wiring at `src/components/GameLayout.tsx:385` and the panel at `:459` with the minimal notices list.
   - On opening Notifications, acknowledge the ids actually shown. A notice arriving later remains unread.
   - Keep the existing button and its accessible unread count (`src/components/GameHeader.tsx:26`) until #9 moves this list into Chronicle.

5. Render the non-blocking toast stack over the existing game view.
   - Desktop: left-middle, up to four notices, newest on top. Touch: one at top-centre, clear of the header and controls; respect safe-area insets.
   - Use chamfered lacquer strips with gold frames, an `Emblem` and readable wrapped text; minimum row height 52 px and body size 13 px. Use display type for names and body type for messages.
   - Use theme tokens and `ui-note-in`; add visual rules to `src/ui/theme/skin.css`. Delete replaced gift-list legacy rules in the same PR. Introduce no new stylesheet exception here.
   - Hold for 2.5–3.2 seconds through CSS animation, then expire through `onAnimationEnd`. Guard against child animation events expiring the parent toast.
   - Toast expiry/dismissal is presentation state. It never acknowledges the persisted entry; Notifications remains the durable unread/history view.
   - Keep expired ids in bounded UI state across scene/menu toggles so they do not replay on every render. Show remaining queued entries as space opens.
   - Queue while a conversation, menu, save view or ceremony obscures the HUD; begin display/expiry when returning to play. Use #4's world mode when available, otherwise the existing overlay flags.
   - A visible toast never changes pause flags. Only the open history panel has the existing menu pause behaviour.
   - Use separate polite and assertive live regions; danger alone is assertive. Announce complete messages once when displayed, without announcing the whole history on each render.
   - Respect reduced motion with a transform-free lifecycle animation that still completes. The existing blanket `animation: none` rule is at `src/ui/theme/skin.css:793`; avoid leaving toasts stuck.
   - Update the module map and glossary for notices/`src/hud/`; remove completed roadmap item 3. Keep toast styling in the documented theme.

## Delete in the same PR

- All five machine `alert()` calls and every direct machine `console.log`.
- The insult `setTimeout`, its captured callback and its timer-only error wrapper.
- `src/lib/courtNotifications.ts`, `src/components/CourtNotifications.tsx`, their imports and runtime `giftNotifications` state.
- `READ_GIFT_NOTIFICATIONS`; replace every caller with `ACK_NOTICES`.
- Old `.gift-notifications` styles in the legacy CSS and theme; replace with the shared notices list styles.
- The source-reading test in `tests/giftNotifications.test.ts`; retain its behavioural guarantees in the replacements below.
- A save-only v7 compatibility projection is allowed until #7. It owns no live state or payout logic.

## New or changed modules

| Module | Interface and responsibility |
|---|---|
| `src/lib/notices.ts` | `pushNotice` / `ackNotices`; owns notice types, ordering, bounds and stable ids. |
| `src/hud/ToastStack.tsx` | Typed notice entries, visibility and expiry/dismiss callbacks; hides plaque layout and announcements. |
| `src/hud/NoticesList.tsx` | Entries plus close callback; reuses `CourtDialog` for a silk-scroll history. #9 reuses its list body. |
| `src/state-machines/game-machine.ts` | Commits notices with existing outcomes; acknowledges ids without changing campaign rules. |
| `src/persistence/campaignSave.ts` | Validates/persists notices and owns the temporary legacy gift conversion. |
| `src/components/GameLayout.tsx` | Connects header/history/toasts and owns bounded volatile toast-expiry state. |

## Tests

- Replace `tests/giftNotifications.test.ts` with `tests/notices.test.ts`, `tests/gameNotices.test.ts` and `tests/noticesUI.test.ts`.
  - Pure interface: 60-entry bound, immutability, cross-season ids, trim then append, partial ACK, repeated ACK and unknown ids.
  - Machine: both gift-credit paths emit once; repeated income reports and reloads cannot repay or append duplicates.
  - Machine: invitation, join, collateral feedback, both pardon branches and both audience completion paths have readable notices. Repeated offer checks stay quiet.
  - Machine: ACK changes only read flags; season, RNG, graph, plots, purse, rank and award ledgers remain unchanged.
  - Mock browser `alert` to throw. Capture console calls and assert the old gameplay receipt/outcome messages are absent; allow unrelated legacy helper diagnostics. Do not regex-match source.
  - Render: full messages, sender/amount/season, empty history, unread header label, severity/live regions and four-versus-one layouts. Exercise expiry and queued visibility through component callbacks/browser interaction.
- Update `tests/romanceLifecycle.test.ts:56` to include canonical notices in its political-state comparison. Preserve the existing romance assertions.
- Extend `tests/campaignSave.test.ts` and `tests/campaignSaveMigration.test.ts`: legacy gift conversion, new notice round trips, partial-field corruption and invalid-entry rejection.
- Extend `tests/gameMachine.test.ts`, `tests/hateRules.test.ts` and `tests/courtGraph.test.ts`: synchronous insult fallout, invalid targets, projection agreement, immunity and immediate save after settlement; advance fake time after stop to prove no deferred mutation.
- Extend `tests/seasonalAllyGifts.test.ts`: payout/notice agreement and no notice from a casualty. Keep its currency expectations through this slice.
- Keep `tests/tributeRanks.test.ts` passing with unchanged tribute rules. Gift resolver, scoring and actor-event replacements listed for synthesis S2 belong to #7.
- If #3 already replaced the source test, extend that interface suite instead of restoring it. Add no source/CSS regex tests.

## Save impact

- Decision: persist notices now as an additive, validated v7 extension. #7 owns the single v8 bump for the economy.
- Add optional serialized `notices: NoticeState`; canonical runtime state always has it. Absence means a legacy save; presence with malformed data fails validation.
- Validate at most 60 entries, unique `${season}:${seq}` ids, ascending safe-integer sequence values, `nextSeq` above retained ids, season within the campaign, recognised variants/severity, boolean read flags and messages of 1–2000 characters. Validate gift names against the full cast and amounts against 1/5/10.
- Map legacy `giftNotifications` once, in stored order, preserving season, sender, amount and read flag. Assign deterministic sequences; preserve the input object and consume no RNG.
- New v7 captures retain the existing serialized `giftNotifications` shape as a derived compatibility projection of the latest 50 gift entries. Canonical notices are authoritative when present; never merge this projection back into them.
- Keep the legacy DTO/validator only inside persistence. Normalize it away before actor restoration; do not maintain two runtime logs.
- #7 must accept original v7 saves and S2a v7 saves, preserve any canonical notices/sequence, and delete the save-only projection when writing v8.
- Use #3's `fromVersion` validator and golden fixtures. Round-trip all four v7 fixtures, acknowledge notices, reload and advance one season. Preserve RNG, people, support, hate, purse, awards and checkpoints during normalization.

## Review notes to handle

- Should fix “S2 is too big”: this PR owns notices and timer removal. Keep catalogue, satchel, gift scoring, economy, seeds and social actor redesign in #7.
- Should fix “no screen between S2 and S4”: ship the minimal Notifications list here. #9 owns the Chronicle placement.
- Must fix 9: retain history-open as an input/clock pause source. Toasts never enter the pause list; integrate the complete #4 overlay contract if it has landed.
- Must fix 13 and the actor-protocol note: keep the current gift/insult events and serial rules here; port the two direct gift-history test consumers and cover synchronous insult settlement through actor interfaces.
- Hook pressure: use CSS lifecycle events and existing render inputs; no new timer/subscription to expire toasts. Verify the reduced-motion path in the browser.

## Hooks that need the owner's OK

- None expected. Use `useState`/`useReducer`, event handlers and CSS animation completion; reuse the existing campaign render subscription.
- Any proposed new `useEffect`, `useMemo`, `useCallback` or subscription must be described to the owner before implementation, with the state/callback alternative. Toast expiry has that alternative above.

## How to check it

1. Open a campaign and form a pledge. Confirm the gift credit appears once as a lacquer notice and in Notifications.
2. Earn a faction invitation, then join. Read the invitation and membership summary; keep walking while a toast is visible.
3. Make a permitted insult in a nonfatal test campaign. Confirm collateral fallout appears immediately and saving/reloading does not repeat it.
4. Use a QA save with a reachable loyalty pardon. Check both payment and refusal bypasses without a browser popup; campaign progression remains the same.
5. Open Notifications, close it and reload. Read entries stay read; unread entries remain available. History access pauses the clock, toast display alone does not.
6. Trigger feedback during a scene/menu, then leave. Check queued display on desktop, phone width and reduced motion; text wraps and toasts expire without obscuring controls.

## Done when

- `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass.
- You loaded the game and looked at the change, including touch and reduced motion.
- All notice sources have interface coverage; insult fallout settles without a timer; ACK and expiry cannot change gameplay.
- Original and S2a v7 saves reload with valid history; the #7 v8 handoff is documented.
- Code review done with GPT-6.1 Sol via T3 `delegate_task` (owner's rule).

title: S1b: Remove the 2D court mode after the owner's decision
body:
> Part of #2 · Slice S1b · Size M · Depends on: #4

**Owner decision required: Q3.** Recommendation: delete the playable 2D court.
Record the owner's answer on this issue before implementation. If the owner keeps a fallback or debug court, revise the plan and define its spatial economy before #7 starts.
**Order:** #4 → #5 → #7. This decision and deletion must land before the item economy.

## What changes for the player

- Every campaign opens in the palace, including campaigns last saved in 2D.
- Courtiers are approached in their zones. The portrait carousel and palace-area dropdown disappear.
- The “2D court” and “Explore palace 3D” toggle disappears.
- Renderer or character failures show recovery controls with the season clock paused.
- The software renderer remains available for navigation QA, with its existing visual limitations.

## Why

- 2D is explicitly untimed today (`docs/GLOSSARY.md:39`). The coming steward stall, gathering and watch limits require spatial play.
- The alternate court has its own presence effect, keyboard listener and screen branch (`src/components/GameLayout.tsx:222`, `src/components/GameLayout.tsx:272`, `src/components/GameLayout.tsx:403`). Removing them gives one place to maintain interaction and timing.
- Failure handling currently switches modes automatically (`src/components/GameLayout.tsx:381`). Deleting only the toggle would leave a hidden route into the removed court.
- Display mode is saved data (`src/persistence/campaignSave.ts:25`). Old 2D saves need deliberate compatibility handling.

## Scope

1. **Record Q3 and confirm the dependency.** Build on #4's shared conversation choices and `worldMode`. This issue removes their temporary classic adapter. Preserve the palace dialogue and its accessible controls.
2. **Remove the classic screen and its controller.**
   - Make `GameLayout` use the palace shell and mount `PalaceScene` throughout its existing campaign-play states.
   - Delete `exploring` UI state, its setter, mode toggle, classic roster derivation, classic presence effect and Left/Right carousel listener.
   - Delete the classic `<main>`, zone picker, `CourtBriefing`, portrait carousel, empty-court copy and court footer.
   - Select a conversation partner by courtier name. Remove carousel-only index/navigation state and props after checking their surviving People-panel callers.
   - Presence continues through `PalaceScene.onPresenceChange`; rank access and gate travel keep their existing rules.
3. **Keep one timing and input policy.**
   - Remove `exploring` from #4's `worldMode` inputs. A renderer that is loading or unavailable produces `blocked`, locked movement and a paused clock.
   - Keep all surviving overlay inputs: save controls, notifications, demotion, season transition, gift pending, conversation, profile, factions, roster and promotion.
   - Preserve inactive-tab pausing. Manual season advancement must also be unavailable while rendering is blocked.
   - Delete the “2D mode is untimed” settings sentence (`src/components/GameLayout.tsx:491`). Update the Season entry in `docs/GLOSSARY.md`.
4. **Remove every mode-switching recovery path.**
   - Replace `PalaceScene.onUnavailable` with explicit failure reporting for renderer/player readiness and imperial staging. It must never select another court screen.
   - WebGL creation failure, context loss and player-model failure keep the palace recovery surface visible. Provide retry using the existing renderer/model lifecycle, plus accessible save/export controls.
   - Keep the software QA link and badge. Preserve the current campaign and save slot when changing renderer; do not silently add `playtest=1` and enter a separate fixture slot.
   - Remove `EmperorEncounter.onContinueIn2D` and its button (`src/components/EmperorEncounter.tsx:13`, `src/components/EmperorEncounter.tsx:29`). Keep “Retry Emperor”.
   - Offer “Continue without arrival animation” for Emperor asset failure. It releases only the presentation arrival gate, once, in the current encounter. It never pays tribute, refuses, advances the season or rerolls the encounter.
   - A missing clear approach path uses a static imperial presentation in the current palace. Remove the classic-court fallback at `src/palace/PalaceScene.tsx:359`.
   - Keep software-mode imperial arrival functional. Its placeholder must reach the same presentation-ready state without requiring a GLB.
   - In the touched tribute view, make “Present tribute” the primary. Refusal requires a second explicit confirmation and is never initial focus or the default Enter action.
5. **Simplify the shared header without removing live controls.**
   - Today `GameHeader` has one implementation and is rendered outside the mode branch (`src/components/GameLayout.tsx:384`, `src/components/GameHeader.tsx:15`). Keep its palace use and shared component until #9.
   - Remove classic-only layout/style paths. Preserve Profile, Court, Notifications, sound and permitted season advancement. Save controls remain reachable during renderer failure.
6. **Normalize legacy display settings, then delete unused styles and tests.** Follow the save and test instructions below in the same PR. No new gameplay events, economy rules or campaign states are needed.

## Delete in the same PR

- Mode toggle, `setExploring`, mode-dependent rendering and classic presence/keyboard effects.
- `src/components/CourtBriefing.tsx` and `src/components/CharacterDisplay.tsx` once their last callers are removed.
- The classic `CourtAudience` adapter inside `GameLayout`; #4 owns the surviving palace conversation renderer.
- Carousel-only handlers, props and imports. Keep People-panel selection working through the remaining court view.
- Classic-only `.court-shell`, `.court-main`, `.court-workspace`, `.court-goal`, `.court-warning`, `.court-footer`, `.empty-court`, `.portrait-stage`, `.court-portrait`, `.portrait-navigation`, `.classic-zone-picker`, `.classic-mode` and `.palace-mode` rules, including media overrides.
- Those rules occur in `src/style.css`, `src/palace/palace.css` and `src/ui/theme/skin.css`; the theme's classic block starts at `src/ui/theme/skin.css:708`. Remove only unused selectors from mixed rules. Retain shared roster, faction, header and character-selection portrait styles.
- All “Continue in 2D” buttons, their props and fallback copy. Keep software materials, SVG rendering, spatial navigation and QA controls.
- Do not leave a hidden classic route, debug flag or dormant mode branch. Do not add replacement rules to frozen legacy CSS.

## New or changed modules

- **`GameLayout`**: one palace presentation, conversation identified by name; hides overlay wiring without a second court controller.
- **`worldMode` from #4**: same derived output (`inputLocked`, `worldFrozen`, `clockRunning`, HUD mode); owns surviving pause rules and renderer blocking. No duplicate OR-list.
- **`PalaceScene` / `EmperorEncounter`**: typed failure and retry callbacks; hide renderer recovery and arrival presentation without changing campaign outcomes.
- **`campaignSave`**: existing `parseCampaignSave` and `captureCampaign` interfaces own legacy display normalization. Callers never branch on the retired mode.
- **Theme**: any recovery presentation uses existing lacquer/scroll surfaces, tokens, Emblem glyphs and `ui-btn` variants. Respect reduced motion.
- No new wrapper, port or runtime abstraction is needed for this deletion.

## Tests

Test rendered output, public rules and save interfaces. Add no source/CSS regex tests.

| Existing file affected | Required replacement or retained coverage |
|---|---|
| `tests/emperorEntrance.test.ts` | Replace the “Continue in 2D” render assertion with retry and explicit animation-skip recovery. Keep cold-loading and arrival gating assertions. Test safe refusal confirmation and no default refusal. |
| `tests/campaignSave.test.ts` | Replace the 2D-mode round-trip expectation at line 58. An input with `exploring: false` loads/captures as palace mode; actors, RNG, relationships, season clock and per-zone poses retain their values. |
| `tests/playtestMode.test.ts` | Replace the assertion that the parsed intrigue fixture keeps `exploring: false`. Keep plot warning, shield casualty, death and restart behaviour unchanged. |
| `tests/campaignSaveMigration.test.ts` | Extend v1–v7 coverage for both valid legacy boolean values. Retain rejection of malformed mode values and v1 absent-field defaults. No relaxation of snapshot validators. |
| `tests/courtIntrigueUI.test.ts` | Simplifying the mode-dependent banner class can break its source assertion. Replace that assertion with a rendered assertive palace warning and working report action; retain its other behaviour tests. |

- Add palace presentation coverage: fresh game and loaded legacy 2D game expose the same conversation controls, with no classic toggle, zone dropdown or carousel.
- Extend #4's `worldMode` tables: roam runs the clock; each surviving overlay pauses it; hidden tab and renderer failure block input/time; retry resumes only after readiness.
- Browser interaction coverage: Left/Right no longer selects a remote courtier; movement and gate access work; People, Profile, Court, Notifications and Save controls remain reachable.
- Recovery coverage: WebGL failure/context loss, player-load failure, Emperor-load failure and blocked imperial approach never open another court, reset the clock, reroll RNG or duplicate a campaign command.

body:
> Part of #2 · Slice S1 · Size XL · Depends on: #3

## What changes for the player

- Courtiers appear near the entrance you used. Running becomes the default; Shift and the touch Walk toggle slow you down. The floor becomes calmer stone.
- Press E near a courtier to enter a letterboxed conversation. Their face stays in view above a silk subtitle and cinnabar nameplate.
- Choose a named courtesy present with a spoken line, offer a romantic present, ask to be lovers, end a romance, or take your leave. Available choices follow today's rules.
- Petals, a leaf, sound and a short written reaction make the result clear. Suspicion and named witnesses remain visible before risky actions.
- The campaign clock stops during conversation. Your partner holds position; other courtiers keep breathing and strolling.
- The purse reads Taels. Scholar's View keeps today's exact effects and personality information available and starts enabled pending the learner balance gate.

## Why

- The shared audience combines a speech bubble, gift form and separate romance panel: `src/components/GameLayout.tsx:157`, `src/components/GameLayout.tsx:160`, `src/components/GameLayout.tsx:161`. The 3D version wraps it in another scroll: `src/components/GameLayout.tsx:440`.
- Pause rules differ between the clock, classic keyboard and palace props: `src/components/GameLayout.tsx:233`, `src/components/GameLayout.tsx:273`, `src/components/GameLayout.tsx:380`. Palace input also queries open dialogs: `src/palace/PalaceScene.tsx:250`, `src/palace/PalaceScene.tsx:265`.
- New courtiers take north-first grid positions and patrol stops from the same candidate list: `src/palace/world.ts:293`, `src/palace/world.ts:300`, `src/palace/world.ts:306`. Sorting that shared list would also bunch patrols near the entrance.
- Conversation framing targets a point 0.45 m above the player floor: `src/palace/PalaceScene.tsx:375`. The reaction flies a tan box between people: `src/palace/PalaceScene.tsx:151`, `src/palace/PalaceScene.tsx:348`.

## Scope

Implement in four reviewable commits on one branch. Each commit removes the path it replaces. Use typed interfaces, no new `any`, and short module ownership comments. Keep presentation randomness away from campaign RNG; this slice adds no random draws.

1. **Derive the scene's data and world policy.**
   - Pull the minimal `selectCourtView(snapshot, ui): CourtView` into this slice. It owns actor reads and converts them into typed values for the selected courtier, player career/rank, purse, relationship, gates, receipts, pending/error state and current presence witnesses. UI components receive values and command callbacks; they never read actors.
   - Normalize legacy role `minister` to the scholar career at this edge. Keep actor identities separate from display names. Split existing `Name: reply` strings once here into `{speaker, line}`; save strings remain unchanged.
   - Implement pure `worldMode({machineValue, ui})`. Return `{mode, inputLocked, worldFrozen, clockRunning, hud}` with modes `roam|scene|menu|cutscene|blocked` and HUD `full|scene|none`.
   - Carry every current flag: exploring, scene, saveMenuOpen, notificationsOpen, demotion, transitionSeason, renderReady, giftPending, showStatsModal, showFactionPanel, showRosterPanel, promotionKey and tabHidden. Include machine states and renderer/model failure readiness. A typed overlay set may replace the individual panel booleans; no flag may vanish during the move.
   - Priority: hidden/unavailable renderer and terminal/loading states block; active imperial flow takes cutscene priority; a blocking panel/ceremony overrides an ordinary scene; scene overrides roam. Closed 2D mode stays untimed and uses the same overlay policy for its keyboard listener.
   - Roam unlocks input and runs the 3D clock. Scene locks locomotion, jump, camera gestures and gates, pauses the clock, and leaves ambient animation live. Pending gifts also lock choice commits. Menus, transition, promotion, demotion and blocked modes freeze ambient simulation and pause the clock.
   - Imperial intro/encounter keeps its existing scripted entrance running while player input and campaign time are locked. Do not freeze that script behind the ambient-world flag. A hidden tab stops its elapsed time.
   - Replace all three GameLayout OR-lists and both PalaceScene dialog guards. Derive classic navigation eligibility from this policy. Reset held keys, touch input and pointer capture on locking; keyup must still clear keys.
   - Pass `inputLocked`, `worldFrozen`, `dialogue` and `onHotkey` to PalaceScene. Pass an engaged set containing the partner and reacting courtiers to world movement; engaged actors idle/look/react while others stroll. Give model updates explicit freeze/engagement semantics without a compatibility `paused` path.

2. **Make the entrance readable.**
   - Extend world creation with an optional entry point. Fresh career entry uses `zoneSpawn`; travel passes the destination gate's inward landing point. Restoring a valid saved player/NPC pose preserves it.
   - Sort a copy of placement candidates by distance to that actual entry point, with a stable tie-break. Preserve the spread and ordering of patrol destinations. Validate collision clearance, separation, reachability and entrance sightlines.
   - With at least two supplied courtiers and no saved poses, place the nearest within 15 m and at least two in the initial view. Apply this to south and side entries. Do not assume Rong, Hua or Maid He exists in the rolled active cast.
   - Reduce the alternating floor contrast at `src/palace/world.ts:76`. Put any new palette value in the theme tokens and pass it through the presentation edge to world materials. Keep material disposal and software rendering working.
   - Reverse the modifier at `src/palace/PalaceScene.tsx:323`: default run, Shift walk. The touch toggle says Walk and resets to run. Update accessible controls text and playtest `walk/run` commands, which currently synthesize Shift for run at `src/palace/PalaceScene.tsx:232`.
   - Keep control speeds unchanged: 1.35 m/s walk and 3.8 m/s run (`src/palace/characterModels.ts:77`). The Ladies' Court is 48 m deep (`src/palace/zones.ts:17`): an unobstructed 48 m traversal is about 36 s walking or 13 s running. Measure the actual browser route separately.

3. **Stage the conversation.**
   - Add pure `stageShot({player, partner, partnerHead?, beat, isClear, reducedMotion})`. Use Vec3 tuples and injected clearance checks; no Three.js imports or DOM reads in this module.
   - Candidate order: right over-the-shoulder, left over-the-shoulder, side two-shot at 2.8 m, then wide at 4.5 m. Validate bounds, camera clearance and sightlines through colliders plus view blockers. Use a safe wide fallback, retaining the last clear exploration shot if every candidate is blocked.
   - While a shot is active, retain existing world rebuild dependencies; roster synchronization belongs to #15.
   - Frame the head in the upper third at FOV 36–40. Enter with a 0.6 s glide; reduced motion cuts. Keep the player visible. Turn both people toward the scene without changing their saved exploration pose.
   - Keep the Emperor override authoritative. Apply ordinary dialogue shots only when that override is inactive. Restore camera position, yaw, pitch, distance, FOV and player visibility on exit, interruption and cleanup.
   - Skip cinematic camera/pose writes in both the periodic save at `src/palace/PalaceScene.tsx:431` and the cleanup save at `src/palace/PalaceScene.tsx:446`. Preserve the pre-scene player pose; ambient NPC positions may continue to save.
   - Extend `characterModels` with `lookAt(name, point|null)`: blend head/neck rotation after mixer updates, clamp yaw to 60 degrees, and clear offsets on exit. Nearby courtiers can look at the player within 4 m. Missing bones and the software adapter safely do nothing.
   - Reuse existing Gift_Present and portrait-light practice. Optional emotes arrive through #17; this slice must work without that file and must leave cast asset hashes unchanged.

4. **Replace the conversation surface and bridge actions.**
   - Build a reducer-driven `DialogueScene` and shared `ConversationChoices`. The 2D CourtAudience uses the same choice model and controls until #5 resolves its removal.
   - Desktop: 9vh letterbox bars, bottom-left cinnabar nameplate, relationship beads and suspicion eye, silk subtitle, right-side numbered choices and a compact dossier. Touch: 6vh bars, full-width subtitle and bottom-sheet choices with at least 52 px targets and safe-area padding.
   - Use a non-modal labelled scene region, safe initial autofocus and roving arrow-key choice focus. Keep Tab/Shift+Tab within scene controls while background controls are inert; restore them on exit. Never claim a native modal focus trap.
   - Use theme fonts, frames, Emblem glyphs and `playCue`; body/hint text is at least 13 px. Add the new scene styles in unlayered `src/ui/theme/hud.css`, imported through `src/ui/styles.css`. Document this exception and `src/hud/` ownership in AGENTS.md and the architecture map.
   - `src/data/courtesyPresents.ts` owns all bridge content: four stances × four court tiers, each with an item name, emblem and accompanying line. Vary lines by office and situation, including a distinct romantic offering. Keep stance tags internal. This is one bounded content table with no inventory, tastes or new scoring.
   - Examples of the intended writing: offer Xuan paper with a line about records to a scholar, or a sachet with a line about the cold gallery to a courtier. Avoid a repeated loyal/ambitious/neutral trio across all people. Budget roughly 40–60 short bridge lines; full personal voices belong to #8.
   - Courtesy presents send existing `GIVE_GIFT_WITH_MESSAGE`; romantic presents/propose/end send existing `ROMANCE_ACTION`; a confirmed cutting remark sends existing `SPIT_IN_FACE`. Use fresh request IDs for the existing deduped paths. Keep the four-phase gift pipeline, scoring, cost, influence gates and all campaign rules unchanged until #7.
   - Use `previewMessage`, `getInfluenceGating`, `giftCost`, romance eligibility and witness risk through CourtView/conversation. Preserve the insult lock above 0.6 influence and ambitious-message lock above 0.8. Show budget and the recipient's present cost once above the offerings; disable unaffordable/pending choices with a reason.
   - Keep 2–4 numbered choices per beat; expand Presents and Romance into their own beats. Take your leave remains visible. One primary action per beat; dangerous actions never receive it.
   - Show named current-zone witnesses and explicit reporting/fatal warnings before romance or a dangerous present. S1 uses machine presence, including pledged exemptions. Spatial 8 m/line-of-sight witnesses belong to #11. Refresh from the same CourtView used to commit; do not advertise spatial privacy yet.
   - Map new gift/romance receipts and changed remark responses to petals/leaf, a cue and a worded scene-local reaction. Play once per new receipt/response; failed evaluations show the existing error and allow retry. Persistent notices and removal of legacy alerts belong to #6.
   - Label the header purse Taels, including its accessible name (`src/components/GameHeader.tsx:23`). Keep the saved `giftsRemaining` field until #7 renames it.
   - Start Scholar's View enabled. Its compact dossier preserves exact previews, personality and support information. Hide those numbers only after the owner agrees to the learner target band from #3 and that gate passes.

## Delete in the same PR

- `ActionButtons.tsx`, `RomanceActions.tsx` including its exported RomanceRisk, and `CourtSpeechBubble.tsx`; move their behaviour into the single scene interface.
- The 3D “A moment at court” CourtDialog invocation, stat dossier in that conversation, tone select, Send gift rows and separate romance details.
- `src/palace/speechPlacement.ts`, its test, speech DOM/projection state, `onSpeechProjectionChange`, `speechAnchored`, and conversation DOM queries.
- The talk-only `chooseViewYaw` use and waist-height target; preserve its Emperor use until that flow is replaced.
- The tan gift mesh, geometry/material creation, flight update and disposal; retain existing model gestures and scene reactions.
- All superseded conversation/action/speech CSS in legacy style.css and palace.css, plus obsolete theme overrides. Keep other CourtDialog consumers and 2D portrait navigation.

## New or changed modules

- `src/lib/courtView.ts`: `selectCourtView(snapshot, ui)` hides actor projection, speaker normalization and legacy-rule derivations. Extend this same selector in #9.
- `src/lib/worldMode.ts`: one pure policy hides pause/input/clock/HUD precedence across 3D and 2D.
- `src/palace/dialogueStage.ts`: `stageShot(input)` hides shot selection, head framing and safe fallback.
- `src/lib/conversation.ts`: `beginConversation(view)`, `conversationChoices(view, state)`, `choose(state, choiceId)` and `reactionFor(receipt)` hide beat order, gates, confirms and command routing. Accept current view data when choosing and revalidate pending/gates. No actors, clock, storage or RNG access.
- `src/data/courtesyPresents.ts`: the sole temporary stance-to-present bridge; delete it in #7.
- `src/hud/DialogueScene.tsx` and shared choices: render typed scene values and emit commands. UI state owns beat, reveal state, focus, selected row and dossier visibility.
- PalaceScene/world/model adapters own rendering, entry placement, procedural gaze and disposal. GameLayout wires them to the selector and commands. Add Conversation, Present, Taels and Band to `docs/GLOSSARY.md` without changing gameplay thresholds.

## Tests

- Add worldMode tables for every flag and priority combination, including 2D keyboard, hidden tab, pending gift during a scene, overlapping panels and imperial entrance. Assert input, ambient freeze and clock independently.
- Add stageShot fixtures through its interface for Ladies' Court, library aisles and north-wing residences: face framing, clearance, ordered fallback, all-blocked fallback and reduced-motion cuts.
- Add placement/world-step tests for each entrance, restored poses, separate spread patrols, engaged partner holds, other courtiers move, and worldFrozen stops ambient motion.
- Add CourtView/conversation fixtures for costs, exact previews in Scholar's View, influence locks, eligible/ineligible romance, pledged exemptions, named reporting witnesses, pending/error retry and command routing.
- Add DialogueScene renders for numbered buttons, full subtitle, separate speaker, no select, disabled pending controls, cost header, risk wording and dangerous confirm. Test actual reducer commands and browser keyboard/focus behaviour; rendered markup alone cannot prove hotkeys.
- `tests/romanceUI.test.ts`: replace bubble/RomanceActions renders and source/CSS regex assertions with scene render and conversation command tests. Keep its CourtIntriguePanel casualty test. Preserve the specific fatal-witness warning assertions.
- `tests/giftTransactions.test.ts:289`: replace the ActionButtons import and form case with shared-choice render/command coverage. Keep every existing transaction/refund/deduplication test unchanged.
- Delete `tests/speechPlacement.test.ts` with its module.
- `tests/palaceZones.test.ts:42`: replace the paused assertion with worldFrozen plus engagement behaviour; preserve saved-pose and route reachability coverage.
- `tests/assetLifecycle.test.ts:155`: migrate model update calls and the pause/reaction case to explicit freeze/engagement semantics. Verify frozen locomotion, scene idle breathing, accepted gestures and lease disposal.
- `tests/princePlayerModel.test.ts:66`: migrate update calls, including the queued landing/gift case. Preserve takeoff interruption, landing completion and no root translation.
- `tests/modelLoading.test.ts`: migrate its world step call if the signature changes; keep software anchors free of placeholder art.
- Re-run `emperorEntrance`, `palaceSchedules`, `ladiesResidences`, `touchGestures`, `rankGiftIncome`, `campaignSave`, `gameMachine` and `courtGraph` suites. Preserve their public behaviour; extend header coverage for Taels. Honor any interface replacements already landed by #3.
- Run the #3 golden v7 parse/advance round trips and learner report. Record all policy medians and the agreed target band; preserve Scholar's View by default if learner fails or the owner has not set that band.

## Save impact

- None. `SAVE_VERSION` remains 7 (`src/persistence/campaignSave.ts:16`); machine states, events, actors, serialized fields and checkpoint whitelist stay unchanged.
- Conversation state and shots are transient. Reload returns to the saved exploration pose. A pending gift remains unsaveable under `src/persistence/campaignSave.ts:135`.
- Existing presentation pose data may update during ordinary roaming. Do not persist cinematic camera values or add bridge inventory/mood fields.

## Review notes to handle

- Must fix 9: scope step 1 covers all three pause lists, both dialog guards and every surviving overlay. Delete these rules at their old callers.
- Must fix 14: a cutting remark first opens a confirmation naming support loss, hate 100 unless immune, suspicion and witnesses. The hate rule is `src/lib/courtGraph.ts:57`. Confirm requires an explicit second button activation; Enter and number hotkeys cannot commit it, and Cancel gets initial focus.
- Apply the same safety contract to future tribute scenes: Present tribute is primary; Refuse gets explicit confirmation and no default/Enter/number target. #13 owns tribute rendering; S1 establishes and tests the shared confirmation convention.
- Hotkeys: reserve WASD for locomotion; use V for dossier, P for subtitle auto-advance, L for log and H for hide. Auto-advance reveals/advances text only and never selects a choice. Ignore modified keys, repeats, editable targets and already-handled events. Consume scene keys before palace movement.
- Esc precedence: close the top confirmation/drawer/log first, then return from a present/romance sub-beat, then leave the scene. A later Esc in roam opens the menu when available. Each press performs one action; pending gifts block leave until settled. Restore focus to the original trigger or canvas after exit.
- Typewriter: visual character spans are `aria-hidden`; one visually hidden `aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` node contains the full line. Reveal instantly on advance before interpreting a choice. Reduced motion displays the whole line without waiting for animationend. Keep a readable current-session log and a visible leave control.
- Placement, contextual writing and crossing times are acceptance requirements in steps 2 and 4. Minimal CourtView ships now. The learner/hidden-number gate from Must fix 3 remains a prerequisite through #3.

## Hooks that need the owner's OK

- No new useEffect/useMemo/useCallback is planned. Use useReducer/useState, ref callbacks for initial safe focus, explicit exit handlers for focus return, CSS reveal events and the existing PalaceScene frame/keydown listener.

- `tabHidden` needs visibility updates for worldMode. Prefer the existing visibility listener feeding UI state, or `useSyncExternalStore` with one app-owned visibility subscription. List a proposed new subscription for owner review before implementing it; the current-frame visibility check remains an immediate input guard.
- If Auto requires new JS timers, or ref callbacks cannot reliably cover forced focus return, request approval for the exact effect/subscription and cleanup. Hook-free alternative: manual advance plus frame-loop timing/ref lifecycle. No new hooks for shots or gaze.

## How to check it

1. Run `npm run dev`, open http://localhost:5173 and start each career. See nearby courtiers without requiring a named opening cast. Run by default; hold Shift and use touch Walk to compare pace.
2. Enter another accessible compound through a side gate. Check people near that entrance and patrols farther into the hall. Measure a stated collision-free route; compare distance/speed with recorded traversal time.
3. Approach anyone and press E. Check head framing, letterbox, nameplate and subtitle. Repeat beside library shelves and in a north-wing room. The player remains visible; the camera stays outside walls.
4. Offer a courtesy present. The purse falls by today's tier cost once, pending controls lock, and one reaction appears. While speaking, the partner holds and other people stroll. Menus freeze them; the clock stays paused.
5. Test eligible romance and a reporting witness. Read the named warning before committing. Open a cutting remark; press Enter, number keys and Esc. None may accidentally send it. Explicitly cancel or confirm.
6. Use Tab/Shift+Tab, numbered safe choices, V/P/L/H and nested Esc. WASD cannot move during a scene. Leaving restores focus/camera without also opening a menu. Switch to 2D and check the same choice rules.
7. Try a phone viewport, reduced motion and a screen reader. Confirm touch targets fit, the subtitle is announced once as a whole sentence, and instant reveal works.
8. Open each surviving panel, trigger promotion/demotion and the first Emperor visit, then hide/restore the tab. Check pause precedence and imperial arrival. Load a v7 fixture, enter/leave a scene and reload; the exploration pose and campaign remain valid.

## Done when

- `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass.
- You loaded the game and looked at the change on desktop and touch layouts, including camera fallbacks and keyboard/accessibility checks above.
- Every old conversation path listed here is removed; #7 has one clearly owned bridge to delete.
- The learner report and Scholar's View default follow the owner's agreed gate.
- Code review done with GPT-6.1 Sol via T3 `delegate_task` (owner's rule).

title: S0: Protect saves, replace source tests, and establish honest sim baselines
body:
> Part of #2 · Slice S0 · Size L · Depends on: nothing

## What changes for the player

- The game looks and plays the same.
- Existing campaigns keep their careers, court graph, gifts and history.
- Save loading, romance warnings, demotion recaps and gift receipts gain regression coverage.
- Later slices gain a balance gate for a player learning through the proposed UI.

## Why

- Save validation takes five legacy switches. The parser derives them from versions 3–7 (`src/persistence/campaignSave.ts:103`, `src/persistence/campaignSave.ts:247`). A rebuild needs one version boundary.
- Four UI suites inspect source or CSS spelling. They can pass while behaviour breaks and fail after harmless refactoring (`tests/romanceUI.test.ts:7`, `tests/courtIntrigueUI.test.ts:6`, `tests/demotionNotice.test.ts:10`, `tests/giftNotifications.test.ts:7`).
- The sim ranks zones and gifts using exact support previews, traits and faction inference (`scripts/simulate-campaign.ts:72`, `scripts/simulate-campaign.ts:98`). Those inputs exceed the proposed learner UI.
- The default sim report goes into a missing `validation/` directory (`scripts/simulate-campaign.ts:139`). Record a reproducible baseline before changing its policies.

## Scope

1. **Freeze evidence before refactoring.**
   - Copy `public/qa/{intrigue,demotion,jealousy,romance}.json` byte-for-byte into `tests/fixtures/saves/v7/`, preserving the filenames.
   - These are four real `harem-empire` v7 saves. Record their SHA-256 values and provenance beside the fixtures. Never regenerate them from the current machine.
   - Run the unmodified sim: `SIM_REPORT_PATH=/tmp/harem-sim-s0-before.json node --import tsx scripts/simulate-campaign.ts 100 1 60`.
   - Commit its summaries and assumptions to `docs/validation/s0-simulation-baseline.md`; commit the raw report under `tests/fixtures/simulation/s0-legacy.json`. Include revision, command, Node version, roles, policies, seeds 1–100 and horizon 60.
   - The review run reported strategic median first promotions of 6/11/10 and win rates of 96/91/93% for Prince/Scholar/Concubine. Casual and focused Scholar/Concubine promotion rates were 0%. Treat these as comparison clues; record the fresh run's actual results.

2. **Exercise the golden saves through persistence and the real machine.**
   - Parse each frozen file, construct/start an actor with `campaignActorOptions`, capture, serialize, parse again and restore.
   - Compare domain state after reload: career, rank, season, global support, gifts, court graph, actor projections/serials, plots, deceased courtiers, romance and request ledgers, notices, `rngState`, introduction markers and presentation.
   - Exclude only capture timestamps and runtime actor identities from equality. Compare actor state by courtier name.
   - Advance exactly one season, settle any real Emperor tribute prompt through the public event, capture and reload again. Assert no actor error or duplicate payment/settlement.
   - Compare an uninterrupted actor and a reload-before-advance actor from the same golden save. Loading itself consumes no campaign RNG.
   - Pin current first-season outcomes: intrigue warns about General Zhao attacking the player in season 2; jealousy warns about General Zhao attacking Scholar Qin in season 2; demotion reaches season 21 with an unread Grand Prince → Prince deadline notice; romance reaches season 2 with its relationship history intact.
   - Preserve jealousy/romance's already-completed introduction at elapsed 75. The later retime must migrate these fixtures explicitly.

3. **Replace the validator switches with a version.**
   - Use `validateCampaignSnapshot(value, fromVersion = SAVE_VERSION)`. Check that the version is a supported integer.
   - Preserve the existing boundaries exactly: influence `<3`, court graph `<4`, plots `<5`, gift ledgers `<6`, romance `<7`.
   - The parser passes the original file version before migration and `SAVE_VERSION` after migration. Current callers retain strict validation.
   - Keep all rejection checks, graph/projection serial checks and save checkpoint rules. Reformat the touched validation function into readable statements.
   - Keep `SAVE_VERSION = 7`. New v8 fields, the first-visit retime and domain-save redesign belong to later slices.

4. **Replace source assertions with behaviour tests now.**
   - Keep existing useful machine and rendered-markup assertions in the four affected suites. Replace only their source/CSS inspections.
   - Use `node:test`, component renders, mounted React DOM for user interactions/timers, and public machine events. Add a small dev-only DOM harness if required.
   - Render `GameLayout` in its existing 2D path for layout integration. Exercise the 3D speech path through its production frame/projection interface and browser checks.
   - If a production boundary needs extraction, move the real behaviour and wire its callers to it. Avoid test-only exports or duplicate logic.
   - Inspect `playtestMode` and `castRegistry` and record the decisions in the PR: both read data and keep their file reads.

5. **Separate learner decisions from hidden sim telemetry.**
   - Add `learner` to the policy type, CLI filter validation, default policy list, report assumptions and summaries. Existing policies are declared at `scripts/simulate-campaign.ts:27`.
   - Put learner decisions behind a typed value interface: `chooseLearnerAction(observation, memory, rng)`. It receives no actors, campaign context, graph or resolver functions.
   - Observation may include career/rank, purse, visible promotion progress, accessible zones/presence, office tags, public prices/grades, enabled actions, bond band, suspicion-eye state, named witnesses, discovered verdict glyphs and sourced Brush Notes.
   - Exclude exact courtier support/affection/hate, personality vectors, hidden faction, future outcomes, exact preview deltas and unobserved tastes. Public action locks may appear with their displayed reason.
   - Start with empty knowledge. Explore affordable enabled choices using the injected seeded policy RNG; retain coarse observed outcomes and prefer learned favourable choices. Use public office tags as hints where authored data exists.
